title: Transforming LLM to SLM
description: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer broad reasoning but are costly, resource-heavy, and prone to hallucinations. Small Language Models (SLMs) deliver efficient, reliable, and domain-specific intelligence, making them ideal for edge computing and regulated industries. The future of AI lies in a hybrid ecosystem where SLMs handle precision tasks and LLMs provide creativity and cross-domain synthesis.
